manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian exiled by Fiend Hunter
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Fiend Hunter and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from exile to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Fiend Hunter to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Fiend Hunter and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Fiend Hunter and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
